name: Regent Taipei
insider_take: Sophisticated urban elegance meets Taiwanese hospitality in the heart of Zhongshan District, where luxury shopping and cultural discoveries await just steps away.
whats_special: This luxury landmark sits atop the prestigious Regent Galleria shopping complex, offering direct access to high-end boutiques and designer stores. The hotel's prime location on Zhongshan North Road places you in Taiwan's diplomatic quarter, surrounded by embassies and upscale neighborhoods. The property features stunning city views and is renowned for its exceptional Cantonese cuisine at Silks Palace restaurant.
pro_tip: Book a room on the higher floors facing east for spectacular sunrise views over the Taipei cityscape and distant mountains.
dont_miss: The nearby Xingtian Temple (5-minute walk) is one of Taipei's most atmospheric temples, especially magical at dawn when locals come to pray. Explore the trendy Zhongshan Creative Park for local art and design, or take a short stroll to the historic Huashan 1914 Creative Park for cultural exhibitions and artisanal shops.
pros: Prime location in Zhongshan District near shopping and business areas
Exceptional service with personalized attention and multilingual staff
Elegant rooms with premium amenities and city views
Outstanding dining options including renowned restaurants and bars
cons: Located in busy urban area with city traffic
